summary: Focused regression for the Pedidos PDF download fix (Content-Disposition: attachment + green palette + frontend anchor download + success toast). Backend: 17/17 pytest tests passed including a new dedicated test_pdf_endpoint_has_attachment_content_disposition that asserts HTTP 200, content-type application/pdf, Content-Disposition contains 'attachment' AND the order number filename, body starts with %PDF, size > 2KB (logo embedded). Frontend Playwright: logged in as leonicelaboratorio@lumix.com (Laboratorio mode), created PED-0008 with 2 items (TEST_LeitePDF, TEST_CafePDF), clicked order-pdf-{id} -> Playwright download event fired with filename PED-0008.pdf (9291 bytes, %PDF signature) AND in-page success toast 'PDF gerado — verifique seus downloads' rendered. Direct in-page fetch confirmed headers: content-disposition='attachment; filename="PED-0008.pdf"' and content-type='application/pdf'. Regression: order-share-{id}, order-mark-sent-{id}, order-mark-received-{id} all present on the same card. Test order was cleaned up via the trash button (Pedido excluido toast confirmed).
passed_tests: test_pdf_endpoint_has_attachment_content_disposition (new) — asserts Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="PED-XXXX.pdf" and PDF size > 2KB
All 15 other pre-existing pedidos tests (access control, catalog CRUD, order CRUD, status workflow, delete)

Frontend E2E: login -> /pedidos -> Fazer Pedido -> avulso supplier -> Litros -> 2 new items -> finalize -> PED-0008 card -> click order-pdf-{id} -> Playwright download event fired (PED-0008.pdf, 9291B, %PDF) -> toast 'PDF gerado — verifique seus downloads' visible
Frontend regression: Share + status buttons still present and rendered on the order card
critical_code_review_comments: Backend purchase_order_pdf now correctly uses Content-Disposition: attachment (line 3786 of server.py) and the green Lumix palette #0B8F5A / #066A43 / soft #ECFAF3 (lines 3665-3666).
Frontend handlePdf in Pedidos.js (line 451) creates a real anchor with download attribute and revokeObjectURL after 60s — cross-platform safe including mobile.
Success toast uses sonner and was verified to render with exact text 'PDF gerado — verifique seus downloads'.

Minor (non-blocking): two console warnings 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — accessibility-only, not functional. Consider adding <DialogDescription> inside the Novo Pedido dialog and the Excluir Pedido dialog.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up: 1 ephemeral avulso order (PED-0008) via frontend (deleted via order-delete trash button); backend tests create TEST_Fornecedor + TEST_ items and clean up in teardown_module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pedidos PDF fix is fully validated: backend serves PDF with Content-Disposition: attachment and green palette; frontend triggers a true file download via anchor[download] + shows success toast. Two cosmetic a11y warnings remain (missing DialogDescription in Novo Pedido and Excluir Pedido dialogs); not a blocker. Test file path: /app/backend/tests/test_pedidos.py. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_pedidos.py -v.
rca of the issue: Root cause of original bug: backend was sending Content-Disposition: inline (browsers open inline PDFs on mobile in a new tab instead of saving). Fix: changed to 'attachment; filename="PED-XXXX.pdf"' and frontend now builds an <a download> anchor from the blob URL — both layers cooperate to force a real download on every platform. PDF color migrated from blue to green Lumix palette (#0B8F5A primary, #066A43 dark, #ECFAF3 soft green for table zebra). Verified end-to-end.
